fusions.name: Crack of Canvas
fusions.desc: Snaps a sail around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking each back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Last Stitch
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 25% health for 22 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on such a target.

fusions.name: Fothered Leak
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Lampblack Canvas
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
